script:
set -e
export DENO_INSTALL=$HOME/.deno
command -v $DENO_INSTALL/bin/deno >/dev/null 2>&1 || (curl -fsSL https://deno.land/install.sh | sh -s -- -y >/dev/null 2>&1)
cd /workspace/neural-landscape
export GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0 GIT_LFS_SKIP_SMUDGE=1; timeout 60 git pull -q --ff-only || true
rm -rf artifacts/gt/flight-03
$DENO_INSTALL/bin/deno run --allow-read --allow-write --allow-net --allow-run --allow-env \
  --node-modules-dir=auto --unstable-webgpu tools/offline-render.ts \
  --flight=flight-03 --fps=4 --duration=5 --width=960 --height=540 --gt --gt-ss=2 --no-cache \
  --output=artifacts/video/validate-rgb.mp4
$DENO_INSTALL/bin/deno run --allow-read --allow-write --node-modules-dir=auto tools/gt-viz-frames.ts artifacts/gt/flight-03
$DENO_INSTALL/bin/deno run --allow-read --allow-write --node-modules-dir=auto tools/gt-instances.ts artifacts/gt/flight-03
cp artifacts/gt/flight-03/viz-depth/depth_0001.png /tmp/validate-depth1.png
cp artifacts/gt/flight-03/normal_0001.png /tmp/validate-normal1.png
cp artifacts/gt/flight-03/viz-instance/instance_0001.png /tmp/validate-instance1.png
ffmpeg -nostdin -y -v error -ss 0 -i artifacts/video/validate-rgb.mp4 -frames:v 1 /tmp/validate-rgb1.png
python3 /workspace/pod-runtime/pod/hf_upload.py --repo miguelemosreverte/alambique-datasets --prefix preview/validate-ss2 \
  artifacts/video/validate-rgb.mp4 /tmp/validate-rgb1.png /tmp/validate-depth1.png /tmp/validate-normal1.png /tmp/validate-instance1.png
echo VALIDATE-SS2-DONE
